definitions.gloss: rate of decline; rate of fall
definitions.explanation: How far a figure has fallen, expressed as a percentage of its earlier value. Used of prices, share values, and land values.

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}の{下落率|げらくりつ}は{五|ご}パーセントだ。
examples.english: This month's rate of decline is five percent.

examples.japanese: {株価|かぶか}の{下落率|げらくりつ}が{予想|よそう}より{大|おお}きかった。
examples.english: The rate of decline in share prices was larger than expected.

examples.japanese: {地方|ちほう}の{地価|ちか}は{下落率|げらくりつ}が{年々|ねんねん}{縮|ちぢ}まり、{回復|かいふく}の{兆|きざ}しが{見|み}えてきた。
examples.english: The rate of decline in rural land prices has narrowed year by year, and signs of recovery are appearing.

notes:
{下落|げらく} (fall, drop) + {率|りつ} (rate, ratio). Standard vocabulary in financial and economic news, normally quoted against the previous month or year.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {株価|かぶか}の{下落率|げらくりつ}: the rate of decline in share prices
- {下落率|げらくりつ}が{大|おお}きい: to have a steep rate of decline
- {前年比|ぜんねんひ}の{下落率|げらくりつ}: the year-on-year rate of decline

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {上昇率|じょうしょうりつ}: rate of increase — the direct opposite
- {下落幅|げらくはば}: extent of the fall — the absolute amount, not a percentage
